name: STEAL!
source:
There is a thief group called Manuspica, and there is also a thief training school managed by the same group. One day, Asuka, who has special powered eyes, transfers to the school and he is sent to a team full of trouble students. In such a hard situation, Asuka completes various missions with them. However, a secret conspiracy and mystery stand in front of them...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
有一个名为Manuspica的盗贼团，同时还经营着一所盗贼培训学校。一天，拥有特殊眼睛能力的明日叶转入学校，被分配到一支由问题学生组成的队伍。在艰难处境下，明日叶与他们共同完成各种任务。然而，一场秘密阴谋与重重谜团正在前方等待众人…

[摘自ErogeShop]
